operational.description: Repository availability and observable default-branch automation health.

governance.description: Portfolio review, status-declaration, lifecycle, and repository identity governance checks.

assurance.description: Repository-specific assurance evidence coverage, execution state, provenance and freshness against governed repository revisions.

cross_specification.description: Cross-specification pressure-test evidence is not yet ingested as a portfolio-wide assurance dimension.

findings.subject: repository
findings.claim: An active flagship repository has exceeded the configured activity-review threshold.
findings.recommended_action: Review whether the declared lifecycle and operational status remain accurate. Activity alone does not determine health.

remediation.objective: Review whether the declared active lifecycle and operational status remain accurate; activity alone must not force a status change.
acceptance_criteria: A human review confirms or updates the declared lifecycle and operational status.
verification: Rerun portfolio validation and the monitor after any governed metadata change.

handoff.intended_use: Supply this dossier with the affected repository source during remediation planning and implementation.
handoff.closure_rule: A finding is closed only when a later monitor run no longer observes the condition and records closure evidence in the lifecycle registry.
